assertion_audit: check_mutation.py:38-41 fails if either source mutation site is absent or duplicated, so the test cannot silently skip suppressing it.

check_mutation.py:62-68 fails if the suppressed child succeeds or fails for a reason other than the named booking guard; reverting the new guard makes the child succeed, as control-reverted.log records.

measure.py:244-252 fails if either measured error is nonfinite or the perturbed booking error does not exceed both 1e-6 and ten times the paired unperturbed control; deleting the matrix perturbations makes the two errors equal and triggers the refusal.
run_control_check.sh:37-39 intends to fail if the pre-repair arm refuses the suppression, but at the final head its HEAD^ input is the repaired commit, so it fails even when the guard is correct.
No added comparison passes the same variable to both sides; the paired control_action is computed from the unmutated held matrix while the compared booking action uses the perturbed matrix.

evidence.suite_comparison_note: baseline_suite and after_suite are empty in the reviewed manifest; zero is the count of observed added failure IDs, not evidence of a paired suite pass.

findings.text: At reviewed head ae7be5c8, HEAD^ resolves to fixed commit 29f13d88, so the bundled reversion arm checks the repaired guard and line 37 reports failure instead of reproducing the pre-repair guard; resolve the pre-repair revision from the guard-changing commit or pass it explicitly.

item_verdicts.diff: read d9088cd9, 29f13d88 and ae7be5c8 commit by commit; they add a suppression checker, paired booking control and matching fragment text, plus a launcher whose HEAD^ assumption expires after the final docs commit.
item_verdicts.done_when: brief.txt:2-8 requires a same-state derivative ladder and discriminating control; control-perturbed.log records a 109.5215 ratio and control-suppressed.log records the named refusal, but run_control_check.sh:8 misselects the pre-repair arm at the reviewed head.
item_verdicts.goal: brief.txt:1-8 requests a P100 plateau attribution; measure.py:185-257 repairs the booking-block negative control for that attribution without changing the product solver.
item_verdicts.manifest: source manifest.md:5-29 names all three added commits and the control logs, with baseline_suite and after_suite empty, so no paired suite comparison is available.
item_verdicts.write_paths: source manifest.md:3 grants the bank_step_plateau prototype and evidence fragment; git diff a8ef0ce..ae7be5c changes exactly five paths within those grants.

justifications.durability: check_mutation.py:38-68 makes source suppression fail unless the named guard refuses it, but run_control_check.sh:8 prevents its bundled red arm from reproducing at the final head.
justifications.evidence: control-perturbed.log records 7.863869862e-4 versus 7.180208028e-6, control-suppressed.log records the exact refusal, and control-reverted.log records the old guard accepting suppression; source manifest.md has no complete suite arms.
justifications.fit: check_mutation.py:42-68 follows the local scratch-control idiom, while run_control_check.sh:8 relies on a commit's immediate parent remaining the pre-repair revision.
justifications.goal_fidelity: scripts/prototypes/bank_step_plateau/measure.py:242-257 now rejects an unperturbed booking error instead of treating it as a detected matrix mutation.
justifications.reuse: A capability search found scripts/prototypes/bank_step_booking/negative_control.py:11-101 as a scratch mutation of product performance, but no owner for suppressing a measurement-script mutation and checking its named refusal; check_mutation.py:32-68 serves that separate control.
justifications.scope_discipline: The five paths in a8ef0ce..ae7be5c are all inside the source manifest.md:3 grants and no nova/equilibrium product source changed.
